Rashi on Arakhin 27a:10:1.hebrew: דמצות גאולה באדון - בפ"ק דבכורות (דף יג.):
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:10:1.english: That the mitzvah of redemption [is] with the owner - In the first chapter of Bekhorot (13a):

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:11:1.english: [He bids] more and redeems it - He adds [to the bid] and redeems [it] for more than any other person:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:11:2.hebrew: מצות גאולה באדון - דכתיב: "ואם לא יגאל ונמכר בערכך", אלמא מצות גאולה קודמת למכירה:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:11:2.english: The mitzvah of redemption [is] with the owner - as it is written: "And if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation"; thus [we see that] the mitzvah of redemption precedes sale:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:13:1.hebrew: והא קי"ל שוה כסף ככסף - דאמרי' בבבא קמא (דף ז.): "ישיב" — לרבות שוה כסף, אפי' סובין:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:13:1.english: But don’t we maintain [that] the equivalent [value of] money is [the same] as money - As we say in Bava Kamma (7a): "[He shall] return" — [this comes] to include the equivalent [value of] money, even bran:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:14:1.hebrew: הך סתמא - דקתני "מפסיד איסר" ולא קתני "נמצא מפסיד ביצה", רבנן היא ולא רבי יוסי:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:14:1.english: This anonymous [statement] - which teaches "he loses an issar" and does not teach "as a result, he loses an egg" — is [in accordance with] the Rabbis, and not Rabbi Yosei:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:15:1.hebrew: ממשכנין מנכסיו עשר סלעים - נמצא ביד גזבר עשרים, וכן של שלשים יתן שלשים, הרי חמשים:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:15:1.english: They repossess ten sela from his property - [After both the fifty- and forty-sela bidders reneged,] there are twenty [sela] in the treasurer's hand, and thus [the bidder of] thirty gives thirty, making fifty [in total]:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:17:1.hebrew: אמר אחד הרי היא שלי בכ"א - לאחר שאמרו בעלים בעשרים:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:17:1.english: [If] one [other person] said, "It is hereby mine for twenty-one [sela]" - after the owners said [they would pay] twenty [sela]:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:1:1.hebrew: והכא קרא אחרינא אשכח ודרוש - דהקדישה ואח"כ מת אביו תיהוי אחוזה, דאל"כ, דלא רבי לן קרא אלא מת אביו ואח"כ הקדישה, ניכתוב קרא "אשר לא אחוזתו", ומתרביא הא דר' מאיר דדריש: "יצתה זו שהיא כבר אחוזה":
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:1:1.english: And here they found another verse and expounded [it] - that [if] he consecrated it and afterward his father died, it should be [considered] an ancestral [field]. For if it were not so — that the verse only included for us [the case where] his father died and afterward he consecrated it — the verse should have written, "which is not his ancestral [field]," and [from that] that [law] of Rabbi Meir would [already] be included, as he expounds: "excluding this [field], which is already [his] ancestral [field]."

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:1:2.hebrew: משדה למה לי - ש"מ לכדאמרינן, למדרש הקדישה ואח"כ מת אביו:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:1:2.english: Why do I need “of [his ancestral] field”? - Learn from this [that it is] as we said, to expound [the case where] he consecrated it and afterward his father died:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:1:3.english: This [field] is excluded - for at the time of consecration it was fit to become an ancestral field:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:2:1.hebrew: אפי' ישראל נמי - דהא תניא בריש פירקין (ערכין דף כד.): "מקדישין לפני היובל" וכו' (ואי משום דקתני מתני', "אין מקדישין פחות משתי שנים לפני היובל", הא אוקימנא (שם) דעצה טובה קמ״ל):
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:2:1.english: Even an Israelite as well - For it was taught [in a baraita] at the beginning of our chapter (Arakhin 24a): "[They may] consecrate before the Jubilee," etc. (And if [you raise a difficulty] because the Mishnah teaches, "One may not consecrate less than two years before the Jubilee," we have already established (ibid.) that it teaches us [this as] good advice).

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:3:1.hebrew: הניחא לשמואל דאמר - גבי ישראל לא קדשה, אצטריך לאשמועי' דגבי כהנים קדשה:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:3:1.english: This works out well according to Shmuel, who says - regarding an Israelite it is not consecrated; [therefore,] it was necessary to teach us that regarding priests it is consecrated:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:3:2.hebrew: אלא לרב - ליכא למימר הכי, דמהיכא תיתי לן מקראי:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:3:2.english: But according to Rav - one cannot say this, for from where would we derive it from the verses:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:4:1.hebrew: איידי דתנא רישא - גבי ישראל, תנא סיפא גבי לוים:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:4:1.english: Since [the tanna] taught the first [mishna] - [regarding] Israelites, he taught the latter [mishna] regarding Levites:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:7:1.english: One who consecrates his field at a time when there is no Jubilee - at a time when the Jubilee is not in effect:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:7:2.hebrew: פתח אתה ראשון - בכמה אתה רוצה לפדותה? ומפני ריוח של הקדש שואלין לו תחלה:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:7:2.english: You open first - [State] for how much you want to redeem it, and because of the profit of the Temple treasury, they ask him first:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:7:3.hebrew: שהבעלים נותנין חומש - ולהכי נקט "בשעה שאין היובל נוהג", דבזמן שנוהג אין צריך לשואלו בכמה תפדנה, שהרי דמיה קצובין: בית כור בנ' סלע. ובשדה אחוזה קא מיירי. ובזמן שאין יובל נוהג נפדית בשוייה, כדתניא בשילהי פירקין: "אין שדה אחוזה נוהג אלא בזמן שהיובל נוהג":
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:7:3.english: As the owners give one-fifth - And for this reason [the Tanna] stated, "during a period when the Jubilee is not in effect," because at a time when it is in effect, there is no need to ask him, "For how much will you redeem it?" since its value is fixed: a beit kor for fifty sela. And [the Mishnah] is speaking of an ancestral field. And at a time when the Jubilee is not in effect, it is redeemed at its [actual] value, as it is taught [in a baraita] at the end of our chapter: "[The law of] an ancestral field applies only at a time when the Jubilee is in effect":

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:8:1.english: Due to its inferior quality - [Meaning] that its expenses exceeded the yield:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:8:2.hebrew: לא אמר זה באיסר אלא - "הרי היא שלי בביצה", שהקדש נפדה בכסף ובשוה כסף:
Rashi on Arakhin 27a:8:2.english: That [person] did not say [it] for an issar, rather - [he said,] "It is hereby mine for an egg," as consecrated [property] is redeemed with money or with the equivalent [value] of money:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:8:3.english: He said to him - the treasurer:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:8:4.english: I have caused [it] to reach you - [Meaning,] it is hereby yours:

Rashi on Arakhin 27a:9:1.english: But isn't it taught [in a baraita] that they force - the owner to open [the bidding] first:

Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:13:1.hebrew: רבי יוסי סבר בכביצה נמי פרקינן - ובפ' הזהב (ב"מ דף נג:) איכא פלוגתא: איכא מ"ד בו ובחומשו, ואיכא מאן דאמר בו אע"ג שאין בחומשו. ונראה דכביצה היינו שוה פרוטה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:13:1.english: Rabbi Yosei holds [that] we may even redeem with an egg - And in the chapter [entitled] HaZahav (Bava Metzia 53b) there is a dispute: there is one who says [that a peruta is required both] in it and in its fifth, and there is one who says [that it is required] in it even though there is not [a peruta's worth] in its fifth. And it appears that an egg['s value] is [equivalent to] the value of a peruta:

Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:7:1.hebrew: המקדיש שדהו בשעה שאין היובל נוהג - פירוש: בזמן שאין היובל נוהג, דאז הוא נפדה בשוייו, ויש בו ריוח להקדש לפתוח תחלה הבעלים מפני החומש; אבל בזמן שהיובל נוהג, הוא נפדה לפי זרעו, בנ' סלעים בית זרע חומר שעורים. ובשדה אחוזה מיירי, ובזמן הבית מיירי, דאיכא רווחא להקדש; דאי שלא בזמן הבית, מחללו אם ירצה אפי' לכתחלה על שוה פרוטה, לפי שאין בו ריוח להקדש, דלאיבוד אזיל, כדאיתא לקמן בסוף פירקין (ערכין דף כט.): ההוא דאחרים לנכסיה אתא לקמיה דרב יהודה, א"ל: שקול ד' זוזי, אחיל עלייהו ושדינהו בנהרא ולישתרי לך. וא"ת: היאך נמצא בזמן שאין היובל בזמן הבית? י"ל: בזמן שגלו ישראל, דבעינן "כל יושביה עליה":
Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:7:1.english: One who consecrates his field during a period when the Jubilee is not observed - Meaning: at a time when the Jubilee is not observed, for then it is redeemed according to its value, and there is a profit for the Temple treasury [in having] the owner open [the bidding] first because of the [additional] fifth; whereas at a time when the Jubilee is observed, it is redeemed according to its seed[-capacity], at fifty selas [for] an area [needed to sow] a chomer of barley. And [the Mishnah] is speaking of an ancestral field, and it is speaking of the time of the Temple, when there is a profit for the Temple treasury; for if it were not in the time of the Temple, he could deconsecrate it if he wished even ab initio for [a coin] worth a perutah, because there is no profit in it for the Temple treasury, since it goes to destruction — as it is [stated] later at the end of our chapter (Arakhin 29a): A certain [man] who consecrated his property came before Rav Yehudah; [Rav Yehudah] said to him: Take four zuz, deconsecrate [the property] onto them, and cast them into the river, and [the property] will be permitted to you. And if you ask: How can it be found [that it is] at a time when the Jubilee is not [observed], [yet] in the time of the Temple? One can say: At the time when [part of] Israel was exiled, since we require [that] "all its inhabitants [be] upon it":

Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:8:1.hebrew: אמר ר' יוסי כו' - תימה, איך היה זה המעשה בימי ר' יוסי? והלא ר' יוסי לא היה בזמן הבית, ואם כן לא הוצרך לפתוח תחילה בבעלים! וי"ל דפליג על פי הקבלה ע"פ שאירע בזמן הבית. א"נ, אפי' שלא בזמן הבית גאולה בבעלים תחילה, כדכתיב (ויקרא כ״ז:כ״ז) "אם לא יגאל ונמכר":
Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:8:1.english: Rabbi Yosei says, etc. - This is astonishing: how did this incident take place in the days of Rabbi Yosei? Was Rabbi Yosei not [alive] during the time of the Temple, and if so, it was not necessary to open [the bidding] first with the owner? And one can say that he disagrees based on tradition, according to what occurred during the time of the Temple. Alternatively, even when it is not the time of the Temple, redemption is with the owner first, as it is written (Leviticus 27:27): "If it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold":

Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:9:1.hebrew: מאי אומרין כופין - וא"ת, מ"ש דצריך כפיה הכא טפי מכל הני דתנן בסוף פ"ק דבכורות (דף יג.): מצות פדייה קודמת למצות עריפה, מצות יעידה קודמת למצות פדייה, מצות ייבום קודמת למצות חליצה, מצות גאולה באדון קודמת (למצות) לכל אדם; ומפיק כולהו מקראי התם, ולא אשכחן כפייה כי אם בזה? וי"ל, דשאני הכא, דיכול לבא לידי תקלה אם יהנו העולם ממנה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 27a:9:1.english: What is [the meaning of] "they say"? [It means] they force [him] - And if you ask: Why is coercion needed here more than in all those [cases] that we learned in the Mishnah at the end of the first chapter of Bekhorot (13a): "The mitzvah of redemption precedes the mitzvah of breaking the neck; the mitzvah of designation precedes the mitzvah of redemption; the mitzvah of levirate marriage precedes the mitzvah of ḥalitzah; the mitzvah of redemption by the owner precedes any [other] person," and [the Gemara] derives all of them from verses there, yet we do not find coercion except in this [case]? One can answer that here it is different, because it could lead to a stumbling block [of misuse of consecrated property] if people were to derive benefit from it:
